Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		prodCat: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isNew: Boolean = prodCat.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		prodCat.oclIsUndefined() = isNew and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(prodCat)
	postcondition:
		if isNew 
		then let newProdCat: ProductCatalog in
		newProdCat.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newProdCat) and
		newProdCat.Id = id and
		newProdCat.Name = name 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
